bls.score: SDE of SR = depth_snr / sqrt(N); mean/std(ddof=0), all grid points
bls.spectrum: uniform frequency; same pre-clipping time grid within each star

auroc.definition: global star-balanced AUROC; not mean within-star paired ranking
auroc.outputs: each detector AUROC and CNN-minus-BLS AUROC difference with percentile intervals
auroc.ties: half credit; equivalent to trapezoidal ROC with tied scores grouped
auroc.uncertainty: same 10000 whole-star bootstrap draws as primary recovery, paired across methods
auroc.weights: within each label, each star weight 1/S; positive examples weight 1/(S*m_star)

bootstrap.unit: whole star, same draws for CNN and BLS

test_plan.controls: one per star; fraction flagged; two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson interval
test_plan.diagnostics: period/radius cells and paired ranking descriptive; no subgroup threshold fitting
test_plan.difference: CNN minus BLS recovery; paired whole-star bootstrap
test_plan.injections: all release-eligible trials of allocated active test stars; all phases; fixed stored parameters
test_plan.preprocessing: reuse cnn_calibration.data.baseline_arrays; same timestamp-only singleton mask for each control/injection pair; check surviving injected support before scoring
test_plan.primary: light-curve flagging, not period recovery or confirmed planets
test_plan.recovery: mean of per-star fractions of eligible injections flagged; equal star weights
test_plan.support_failure: stop on loss of all injected support; no outcome-dependent exclusions
test_plan.uncertainty_scope: conditional on frozen models and thresholds; not retraining/calibration uncertainty
